claims.behavior_proved: Accessible workspace login and forced password-change screens call the real shared API through the same-origin proxy. Real persisted temporary credentials exercise forced-change-only route enforcement, password establishment, session revocation, fresh permanent-password login, refresh persistence, non-enumerating unknown-account errors, HttpOnly session-cookie attributes, response-body token absence, keyboard form submission, visible mismatch feedback, API log redaction and authentication-event canary absence.
claims.path_proved: Two focused Playwright scenarios ran with a real Vite workspace, Fastify API and isolated PostgreSQL database. No auth-route interception is used. Axe scans passed on login and forced-change screens.
claims.configuration_proved: Clean detached candidate worktree at 76bec16d50e34a9b3ade73a82b640b8a8cb7d07d; Node v26.7.0, npm 12.2.0 and PostgreSQL 18.0. The full DB suite used temporary CI-equivalent migrator role membership and revoked it afterward. Local test profile only. The test session cookie is intentionally not Secure on HTTP loopback; production Secure-cookie behavior was not exercised.
